Hello Fortune Studios team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for photo and video studios in Chennai. I was looking at fortunestudios.in this week. Your site is clear and honest about what Fortune Studios offers, and that wide shot of the motorbike between the softboxes shows the space better than any description.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:
A:
See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/fortune-studios/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. As photographers scroll, they walk onto a live music-video shoot in Studio 1, then past the motorbike on white, a built set and a band on the cyclorama, before the floor sizes, the three studios and a booking button.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a photo studio for rent in Pallikaranai”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now fortunestudios.in has a few of the basics, but not the full set these tools look for. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

What you get for ₹25,000 (one-time)

  • This new website, live on your own domain (fortunestudios.in)
  • Works smoothly on phones and computers
  • Ready for AI search: your studio sizes, what's included, session lengths, both addresses, hours and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you
  • A “book the studio” button that sends the shoot date straight to your WhatsApp
  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so photographers and filmmakers searching for studios for hire in Pallikaranai can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days

  • Day 1: a quick call, and we start
  • Days 2–3: you send any new photos or changes
  • Day 5: you see the updated version
  • Day 7: it goes live on fortunestudios.in
